sources.note: A gradient-free model-merging method that integrates an instruction-tuned model into a large reasoning model to improve instruction following while preserving the reasoning model's thinking format and quality.

result.definition: Combining the parameters of two or more trained models into one, without further gradient-based training, to transfer a capability from one into the other. OptimalThinkingBench tests it as one of five overthinking mitigations, where -- like the other length-reduction methods -- it tends to trade OverthinkingBench gains against UnderthinkingBench accuracy; RAIN-Merging applies it gradient-free to merge an instruction-tuned model into a large reasoning model to improve instruction-following while preserving its thinking format.
